# S67 — Roadmap editing: park and unpark from the TUI (needs adj 11)

**Findings:**  · **Size:** S · **Tree:**

**Not in this slice:**

## Why

Parking and unparking an item from the TUI saves a trip to the CLI. It waits on adj 11 (open, key ui.slicer-tui; its recommendation is "both", so ork parks itself). Use the confirm bar (ui.confirm, decided #98) and `slicer park ID` / `slicer unpark ID` (../slicer/docs/commands.md:78). The key cannot be p: S57 gives n and p to row moves (decided #112).

## Files

- `internal/tui/keys.go` (new Park binding on P; `p` is previous row).
- `internal/tui/model.go` (confirm handling and runAction, which holds the exact target) and `internal/tui/view.go` (confirm bar text).
- `internal/slicercli/write.go` (new Park and Unpark wrappers, same shape as RelayBegin).
- `internal/daemon/handlers.go` (new write methods item.park and item.unpark).
- `docs/dashboard.md:5` and :219-223 (roadmap editing; the key list).

## Failing tests

- TestParkAsksOnTheConfirmBar: the bar shows the exact `slicer park ID` command.
- TestEnterOnConfirmCancelsPark: Enter is No (view.go:59); no slicer call is made.
- TestYesParksAndRefreshesRow: y runs the call and the row shows parked after refresh.
- TestParkFailureShowsErrorCodeVerbatim (docs/dashboard.md:19-20).
- TestUnparkRoundTrip.

## Implement

1. Write the failing tests first (Failing tests). Run them and watch each fail for its stated reason.
2. `internal/slicercli/write.go`: add Park and Unpark wrappers (`slicer park ID`, `slicer unpark ID`), same shape as RelayBegin (:112), using the project's write path.
3. `internal/daemon/handlers.go`: a write method `item.park` and `item.unpark` (proposed names; params project and item). It refuses `park` with bad_params when the item has an unfinished engine run, and returns slicer's error code and message verbatim.
4. `internal/tui/keys.go`: a Park binding on `P` (shift+p). `p` stays previous row. On the Roadmap view it parks the selected item, or unparks it when it is parked.
5. `internal/tui/model.go` and `view.go`: the confirm bar shows the exact `slicer park ID` or `slicer unpark ID`; Enter is No (decision 98); y calls the daemon, then refreshes the row.
6. `docs/dashboard.md:5,219-223` and the key list: say P parks and unparks and is refused on a running item.
7. Run go test ./internal/tui -update and review the golden diff.
Decided 2026-10-23 (owner interview): P (shift+p) toggles park; park is refused when the item has an unfinished run. Nothing is open.
